This page will no longer be updated, only 2021 data is available. Please refer to the [voting sections] page (https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/sections-de-vote)

The set presents information related to the various polling stations in Montreal.

Several [related data sets] (https://donnees.montreal.ca/search?q=tags:%C3%89lections) will be available shortly for the 2021 Montreal municipal election.

More information on the 2021 elections in Montreal on the [portal] (https://elections.montreal.ca/fr/) provided for this purpose.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
